# proxmox_guest_status_action (Resource)

Runs one guest power action (`start`, `stop`, `shutdown`, `suspend`, `resume`, `reboot`, or QEMU-only `reset`) and waits for the node task. Unlike the declarative `power` attribute this resource re-runs whenever `triggers` changes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_guest_status_action" "shutdown" {
  type       = "qemu"
  node       = "pve"
  vmid       = 100
  action     = "shutdown"
  timeout    = 60
  force_stop = 1
  triggers   = { revision = "1" }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String)
- `node` (String)
- `triggers` (Map of String)
- `type` (String)
- `vmid` (Number)

### Optional

- `state_storage` (String)
- `timeout` (Number)
- `to_disk` (Boolean)
